definitions.resource: initial + all received GIVE + EXIT bonus. Completion prize excluded. Transfers can recirculate; this is cumulative resources, not unique tokens.
definitions.talk: Sum ledger call.used for TALK, thinking included, capped at available balance.
definitions.solve_net: Sum ledger call.used for SOLVE minus actual returned tokens; successful solve refunds are subtracted.
definitions.given: Gross executed outgoing transfers; not net gifts or independently estimated cooperation.
definitions.retained: Recorded terminal final balance, EXIT bonus included; completion reward not included.
definitions.resource_pct: Each component / resource * 100. All five components sum to 100 for every agent.
definitions.spend_pct: First four components / spent *100; excludes retained balance. Denominator positive for all 100 agents.
definitions.means: Arithmetic mean of individual percentages, each agent equal weight; not pooled-token shares.
definitions.ordering: Models in existing completion ranking; within model final state, seed, initial allocation. Label seed suffix / initial tokens in 10k / final state; agent ID in CSV.
definitions.inference: Descriptive, outcome-conditioned accounting; no causal or necessary-capability claim and no independent-agent inferential tests.
